title: Smart Throw, Auto Train & Auto Rebirth | Free, No Key
features:
Full auto farm for +1 Stone Skipping. Switch AUTO on and it plays the whole game: training, throwing, stones, eggs, rebirths, auras and the next world.

FEATURES
- Smart Throw: before every purchase it times both ways - throw now, or train to the next distance zone first and throw there - and takes the faster one. Train-only and throw-only modes too
- Trains on your best unlocked stand, auto rebirth as soon as the level allows it, with a few throws first when a purchase is within reach
- Buys stones (the skill multiplier), trails and the best wins egg of the world
- Equips the best pets, fuses three of a kind into Golden, Diamond and Void, clears weak pets when storage is nearly full
- Throws into the portal once the stone flies far enough and moves to the next world
- Daily quests become aura rolls: rolls into empty slots, then over the weakest one, never the best, and wears the best aura
- Playtime gifts, daily reward, offline skill, potions, pet index, the code HALLOWEEN
- Halloween: every free pass tier and the five ghosts of each world
- Tested: from rebirth 2 to rebirth 17 and from World 1 to World 2 in under half an hour

MOBILE
Works on PC and mobile - the panel asks once and scales itself, in German, English and Russian. Every setting survives a rejoin.

HOW TO RUN
1. Open +1 Stone Skipping
2. Paste the loader into your executor
3. Execute - the panel opens by itself
4. Press RightShift to show or hide it

No key, no ads, and it never spends Robux - game-pass stands, Robux eggs and rebirth skips stay shut.
